exact_statements.UniformTargetSelection.guess:
theorem guess [SampleableType G] (run : ProbComp Ω) (event : Ω → Prop) [DecidablePred event]
    (designate : Ω → Option G) (eligible : ∀ outcome, event outcome → designate outcome ≠ none) :
    𝒟[(fun outcome => decide (event outcome)) <$> run] {true} =
      (Fintype.card G : ℝ≥0∞) * 𝒟[(fun pair : G × Ω => decide (event pair.2 ∧ designate pair.2 = some pair.1)) <$> do
        let target ← $ᵗ G
        let outcome ← run
        pure (target, outcome)] {true}
exact_statements.UniformTargetSelection.advantage:
theorem advantage (run : ProbComp Ω) (correct : Ω → Prop) [DecidablePred correct] (designate : Ω → Option G) :
    (𝒟[(fun outcome => decide (correct outcome ∧ (designate outcome).isSome)) <$> run] {true}).toReal -
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (𝒟[(fun outcome => (designate outcome).isSome) <$> run] {true}).toReal =
      ∑ target, ((𝒟[(fun outcome => decide (correct outcome ∧ designate outcome = some target)) <$> run] {true}).toReal -
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (𝒟[(fun outcome => decide (designate outcome = some target)) <$> run] {true}).toReal)
exact_statements.UniformTargetSelection.signed:
theorem signed [SampleableType G] (left right : G → ProbComp Ω) (event : G → Ω → Prop)
    [∀ target, DecidablePred (event target)] :
    ∑ target, ((𝒟[(fun outcome => decide (event target outcome)) <$> left target] {true}).toReal -
        (𝒟[(fun outcome => decide (event target outcome)) <$> right target] {true}).toReal) =
      (Fintype.card G : ℝ) * ((𝒟[(fun pair : G × Ω => decide (event pair.1 pair.2)) <$> do
          let target ← $ᵗ G
          let outcome ← left target
          pure (target, outcome)] {true}).toReal -
        (𝒟[(fun pair : G × Ω => decide (event pair.1 pair.2)) <$> do
          let target ← $ᵗ G
          let outcome ← right target
          pure (target, outcome)] {true}).toReal)

      pinnedKeyId owner.beacon.phase = serverKid ∧ owner.beacon.serverIdentity = server ∧
      buildOf transcript session = some response ∧ codec.write2 fields = some response.serialized ∧
      fields.identity = server ∧ finishOf transcript index = some raw ∧
      (codec.read2 raw).bind codec.ciphertext = some fields.kemCiphertext ∧
      ∀ accepted value, acceptOf transcript session = some accepted →
        PqxdhRegistrationJointRawSignatures.verified setup codec checks accepted = some value →
        PublishedKey setup codec transcript native index value.keys.pqKey

    (pqKey : PqxdhKemIndCca.MlKem768PublicKey) (k : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ published, (bundleOf transcript k).bind (candidateOf codec) = some published ∧

    (pin : Word32) (pqKey : PqxdhKemIndCca.MlKem768PublicKey) (session : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ response accepted keys, buildOf transcript session = some response ∧
    (codec.read2 response.serialized).bind codec.ciphertext = some ciphertext ∧
    (codec.read2 response.serialized).bind codec.serverIdentity = some pin ∧
    (acceptOf transcript session).bind (candidateOf codec) = some accepted ∧
    acceptedKeys crypto accepted = some keys ∧ keys.2.pqKey = pqKey
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.designate:
noncomputable def designate (crypto : Pqxdh.Crypto) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (serverKid : Std.U64)
    (transcript : List Entry) : Handle → Option (Nat × Nat)
  | .peer keyId => do
      let link ← linkOf transcript keyId
      let raw ← acceptOf transcript link.1
      let accepted ← candidateOf codec raw
      let keys ← acceptedKeys crypto accepted
      let k ← (List.range (summarize transcript).owners.length).find? fun k =>
        decide (Publishes codec transcript accepted keys.2.pqKey k)
      pure (link.1, k)
  | .owner index =>
      if phase transcript index = .established then do
        let binding ← (summarize transcript).owners[index]?
        if binding.2 = serverKid then do
          let raw ← finishOf transcript index
          let ciphertext ← (codec.read2 raw).bind codec.ciphertext
          let published ← (bundleOf transcript index).bind (candidateOf codec)
          let pqKey ← publishedPq published
          let session ← (List.range (acceptCount transcript)).find? fun session =>
            decide (Linked crypto codec transcript ciphertext binding.1 pqKey session)
          pure (session, index)
        else none
      else none

deviations_from_plan: Secrecy commands and the transcript are a layer (ledgerImpl) over the trial native handler; the CE handler is the flattened composition, and the compiled program of a complete-interface adversary is the trial compiler applied to the wrapped adversary.

The produced-frame log required extending the trial record commands in place (State, Local, serverStep, beaconStep, serverLocal, beaconLocal, merge). Seven of the twelve trial modules were modified (Interface, Native, Compile, CompileRecords, CompileStep, CompileInvariant, CompileBudget) and four of them gained statements: Interface 6, Native 3, CompileRecords 1, CompileBudget 1, so 11 statements were added to trial modules. CompileStep.compile_run and CompileInvariant.compile_native were adapted: they now start from <native, 0, fun _ => 0, []>. RecordCache, CompileRegistration, CompileFootprint, CompileGame and ReadHistory are unchanged. No trial statement was weakened or removed; statements mentioning the extended definitions changed only by the produced-frame component.

Logs are analysis logs, not public views: the transcript stores mode O replies in both modes (so in mode P it holds raw-receive plaintexts); the adversary view of an entry is Entry.view mode. Produced frames are tagged with FrameTag (the record handle: some (peer keyId) for a Server send, some (owner index) for every Beacon record command, none for a Server raw receive) instead of the plan (side, handle, seq, context); the frame carries sequence number and sender. No plaintext enters the tag, so test and fresh messages never enter Logs.produced. Publication and receipt are functions of the transcript.

A rejected test or fresh command is recorded in the transcript with its none reply; the fresh claim index is the position of the admitted fresh message; Claim has only the fresh-message claim (CE-RG not built). Secrecy claims are stated only for mode P (plan section 3.6, owner input 4); in mode O the secrecy commands are just sends.

Plan change for owner confirmation (alongside plan section 20): qFreshBytes is ellmax times qFresh; the coin cap charges one coin per test (qCoin + qTest + qFreshBytes instead of qCoin + qFreshBytes + 1); the BLAKE2b cap is qHash + S + R + qTest + qFresh (wrapCost counts each test and fresh message as both a Server and a Beacon send). Both sound; later KEM and CTX bills carry the extra terms.

designate compares keys on both sides: the Server side uses acceptedKeys (PqxdhJointPhase1Reports.sourceAccept with the setup source crypto, equal to the RawSignatures.verified result whenever that succeeds, verified_keys) on the accept candidate and publishedPq (split attached PQ field, parsed, no signature check) on the published candidate, plus equality of the identity fields; the Beacon side requires the accept of the linked session to verify to the Beacon published PQ key. Hence the CE-12 Server-side symbolic-eligibility corollary needs only the weak-EUF term (on NoBundleFailure runs), not SUF-CMA or signature uniqueness. The Beacon side checks the pin against the Server identity in the build response (adversary has no input, D5) and owner_link proves with Phase2ReadBack that it is the Server identity.

Deferral against plan section 9 step 9.1, which expected CE-5 designate_keymatch to yield KeyMatchFinal k: designate_keymatch is proved at the deployment level (PublishedKey), which ties the published key to the native KEM pair only until finish (kemPublic is none for Established and Aborted owners). KeyMatchFinal needs a new invariant on the pool-carrying annotated execution of tag (compileFull A) i relating the transcript bundles of owner k to pool key k (true at bundle time by ownership and owner_kemIndex, persistent because the pool only appends) and a relation carrying the compiled transcript into that execution; the existing ownership invariant covers only live KEM pairs. Moved to CE-9 step 9.1; CE-9 re-estimated from 2-4 to 5-10 agent-days. A ghost of the published key in BundleShaped was not added: the native state keeps no KEM key after finish, and merge could not reproduce such a ghost from the source14 state.

approved_goodkem and kernel_reads_unrevealed take a budget premise that the plan statement does not have; the budget-free forms approved_goodkem_unbudgeted and kernel_reads_unrevealed_unbudgeted (via compile_full_unread and simulate_zero) match the plan unconditional statement and were added in the fix pass.
